curated-gf-boldonse-gf-dotgothic16: DotGothic16 is the pixel-edged one, friendly and tube-thick. Boldonse spreads its wide-tracked capitals above it, loud enough for a skate brand tee, so give the heading far more size than the body.
curated-gf-boldonse-gf-finlandica: Boldonse stretches out wide and loud, every stroke the same width. Finlandica is the quieter half, a sans with open-mouthed crossbars that earns its place in copy, while the heading does its best work in just a few big words.
curated-gf-boldonse-gf-slabo-27px: Boldonse sprawls across the top, its s curves bent like wire (think school play poster). Slabo 27px sits tight and dignified below, better for a few lines than for page after page of paragraphs.
curated-gf-bonheur-royale-gf-actor: Actor brings wide, barely curled s shapes and a modern directness (a bumper sticker could use it). Bonheur Royale loops above in casual, low-slung handwriting, and Actor keeps each line tidy beneath that pen-drawn charm.
curated-gf-borel-gf-xanh-mono: Xanh Mono sets code-style letters beneath a Borel header, perfect for a bandcamp page header, though I'd skip that word. Its fixed width and broad, welcoming c feel structured against the looping handwriting, and they hold up for a brief stretch of reading.
curated-gf-bowlby-one-gf-ubuntu-sans-mon: Chunky, rounded and unmistakably loud. Bowlby One fills the line with soft-contrast bowls and earns its keep on big, short headings, while Ubuntu Sans Mono follows in precise monospace, its round letters as sturdy as the straight ones.
curated-gf-bowlby-one-sc-gf-quando: Bold, blocky, and slightly pinched at the mouths. Bowlby One SC hits hardest as a tall woodblock heading, whereas Quando has a bookish, widely spaced text serif that works best as quiet copy underneath.
curated-gf-bruno-ace-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Noto Sans Arabic has wide openings and a pronounced x-height (handy for a motorcycle club, say). Bruno Ace adds its ruler-drawn, one-character-per-beat heading, and a long passage under it would read cleanly and modern.
curated-gf-bruno-ace-gf-pontano-sans: Bruno Ace draws every letter with a ruler-straight, tube-like line, its counters staying open to the outside. Pontano Sans joins it with wide c terminals and a contemporary feel, and the two stay crisp on the same page.
curated-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-bhutuka-expan: Spread-out, beady, unmistakably expressive. Bruno Ace SC leads, and BhuTuka Expanded One slows the reading to a leisurely walk, with curvy serif letters that suit a fishing lodge, say, over a long passage.
